interpretation: Fixed educational low-Re tests, not high-Re or turbulence validation. Ghia errors use linear interpolation to the printed four-decimal coordinates. The actual Thom wall-vorticity and velocity-gradient shear errors are reported and required to decrease; a second-order pointwise wall-vorticity claim is not made. Pressure is a separately manufactured Dirichlet operator problem, never a cavity-pressure validation. No state clipping, retry, hidden filtering or tolerance relaxation.
